market.question: Will the highest temperature in Singapore be 33°C on May 3?

assessment.reasoning: NEA two-week outlook for late April-early May 2026 forecasts daily highs 33-35°C in Singapore with afternoon thunder activity. Bucket of exactly 33°C is plausible but competes with 34°C; probability ~30-35%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Cloud/shower timing at Changi station could shift peak by 1-2°C
